blocks.goal: Extract the nested Type implementation classes out of TypeUtils to reduce class size: GenericArrayTypeImpl, ParameterizedTypeImpl, WildcardTypeImpl and the WildcardTypeBuilder.

ops.details: Create a top-level package-private class GenericArrayTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect with the same fields and methods as the inner class. Keep calls that reference TypeUtils (e.g., TypeUtils.equals, TypeUtils.toString) unchanged so the new class delegates to TypeUtils where needed. Update TypeUtils.java to remove the nested class and import nothing extra (same package).

Create a top-level package-private class ParameterizedTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect replicating the inner class implementation. Maintain usage of TypeUtils.equals and TypeUtils.toString from the new class. Update TypeUtils to remove the nested class definition and reference the new top-level class.

Create a top-level package-private class WildcardTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect with the same implementation as the nested class. Keep calls to TypeUtils.toString and TypeUtils.equals as-is. Update TypeUtils to remove the nested class definition and reference the new top-level class.

Create a top-level public class WildcardTypeBuilder in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect containing the builder implementation. Update TypeUtils.wildcardType() to instantiate and return the new WildcardTypeBuilder. Ensure visibility remains compatible (the builder was public static).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Move type-formatting helpers and joiner fields into a dedicated TypeFormatter class to group cohesive responsibilities (string formatting of Type instances). TypeUtils will delegate formatting calls to TypeFormatter.

ops.details: Create a new package-private TypeFormatter class in org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect that contains static methods implementing the moved formatting helpers. Move the joiner fields AMP_JOINER, CTJ_JOINER, GT_JOINER into TypeFormatter as static fields. Update TypeUtils.toString(Type) and TypeUtils.toLongString(TypeVariable<?>) to delegate to TypeFormatter (e.g., return TypeFormatter.toString(type)). Update any private calls inside TypeUtils to call TypeFormatter.*. Preserve original semantics and visibility by keeping public TypeUtils API methods but delegating implementation.

Move the three AppendableJoiner fields (AMP_JOINER, CTJ_JOINER, GT_JOINER) into TypeFormatter as package-private static final fields used by the moved formatting methods. Remove them from TypeUtils. Ensure their builders use the same element appenders but refer to TypeFormatter.anyToString or TypeFormatter.toString as appropriate.

Add required imports to the new TypeFormatter class (e.g., java.util.Arrays, java.util.Objects, org.apache.commons.lang3.AppendableJoiner, org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils, etc.) mirroring those used by the moved methods. Ensure package declaration is org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect.

Update TypeUtils to delegate formatting work to TypeFormatter. Replace direct calls to the moved private methods and direct field references with calls to TypeFormatter static methods/fields. Keep public signatures in TypeUtils unchanged so external callers are unaffected.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Finalize references to the extracted classes and ensure TypeUtils acts as a small facade delegating to the extracted classes. Update imports and call sites for the moved implementation classes and builder.

ops.details: Update TypeUtils imports if necessary to reference the newly extracted classes in the same package (no package change needed). Ensure wildcardType() and methods that previously instantiated inner classes now create instances of the new top-level classes (e.g., new WildcardTypeBuilder(), new GenericArrayTypeImpl(...), new ParameterizedTypeImpl(...)).

Replace references to nested class names (e.g., TypeUtils.GenericArrayTypeImpl) with the new top-level class names (GenericArrayTypeImpl). Ensure constructors and equals/toString invocations remain valid. Update any visibility issues by keeping the new classes package-private except WildcardTypeBuilder which remains public to preserve API.

Ensure the extracted implementation classes compile by referencing TypeUtils and TypeFormatter as needed. Update any references inside these classes that previously relied on being nested (for example, they might have accessed private members of the outer class). All such accesses have been replaced with calls to public/static methods on TypeUtils or TypeFormatter where necessary.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
